Future<void> save(Object? x) async {}

// CASE dart_callback_no_comment expect=pass
Future<void> c1(List<int> ids, void Function(Future<void> Function()) register) async {
  for (final id in ids) {
    register(() async {
      await save(id);
    });
  }
}

// CASE dart_callback_comment_for expect=pass
Future<void> c2(List<int> ids, void Function(Future<void> Function()) register) async {
  for (final id in ids) {
    register(() async {
      // Replaces for (var i = 0; i < n; i++) in the old code
      await save(id);
    });
  }
}

// CASE dart_callback_doc_for expect=pass
Future<void> c3(List<int> ids, void Function(Future<void> Function()) register) async {
  for (final id in ids) {
    register(() async {
      // Do not use for (;;) here.
      await save(id);
    });
  }
}

// CASE dart_callback_string_for expect=pass
Future<void> c4(List<int> ids, void Function(Future<void> Function()) register) async {
  for (final id in ids) {
    register(() async {
      await save('for (var i = 0; i < 3; i++) $id');
    });
  }
}

// CASE dart_toplevel_comment_for expect=pass
Future<void> c5() async {
  // Old code: for (var i = 0; i < n; i++)
  await save(1);
}

// CASE dart_toplevel_string_for expect=pass
Future<void> c6() async {
  final code = 'for (var i = 0; i < n; i++) {';
  await save(code);
}

// CASE dart_word_for expect=pass
Future<void> c7() async {
  // Wait for (at most) one second; then retry once; if it fails, stop
  await save(1);
}
